name: Alex Morgan
title: Senior Software Engineer | Cloud Platforms | Data & Integration | Automation
summary: Senior software engineer with 10+ years building and operating cloud platforms, data pipelines, and integration services at scale. Proven track record of leading migrations from monoliths to containerised microservices, designing event-driven data flows, and automating delivery with infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD. Comfortable owning a problem end to end — from design and implementation through SIT/UAT, cutover, and post-release support. Pragmatic user of AI-assisted tooling for faster development, with human-in-the-loop review.

projects.title: Cloud Migration & Platform Modernisation
notes: Led the migration of a monolithic application to containerised microservices on Kubernetes, designing end-to-end service boundaries and data flows
Introduced infrastructure-as-code with Terraform and automated CI/CD, cutting release lead time from days to hours
Improved observability with structured logging, metrics, and tracing, reducing mean time to resolution for production incidents
Reduced cloud infrastructure spend by roughly 30% through right-sizing and autoscaling

projects.title: Real-Time Data Pipeline
notes: Designed an event-driven Kafka pipeline processing streaming events with exactly-once semantics and backpressure handling
Built reconciliation and error-tracking reports to surface mismatches and enable branch-level resolution
Exposed curated datasets to analysts via a governed warehouse layer and dashboards

projects.title: API Gateway & Developer Portal
notes: Delivered a unified API gateway with centralised authentication, rate limiting, and request validation
Stood up a self-service developer portal and wrote setup guides and a SIT/UAT test workbook
Trained product teams on the integrated request-to-fulfilment flow

projects.title: Legacy ETL Optimisation
notes: Rewrote nightly batch jobs into incremental, idempotent pipelines with automated validation
Reduced batch window by over 60% and eliminated manual reconciliation steps
Added data-quality checks and alerting to catch upstream anomalies early

projects.title: Internal Automation Toolkit
notes: Built Python utilities to automate recurring data extraction, mapping, and loading tasks
Packaged the tooling with tests and documentation so other teams could adopt it
